Hand-off HO-REG — regulatory citations and filing obligations (concise)

Relevant clauses (IDs and one-line source/title)
- REG-PMLA-R8 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 (Rule 8): Principal Officer shall furnish the Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) to FIU-IND not later than seven working days once satisfied the transaction is suspicious.
- REG-PMLA-R3 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 (Rule 3): Definition — a “suspicious transaction” is any transaction (cash or non-cash) giving reasonable grounds of suspicion, regardless of amount.
- REG-PMLA-R7 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 (Rule 7): Every reporting entity must designate a Principal Officer responsible for reviewing alerts and furnishing verified STRs to FIU-IND.
- REG-PMLA-S12 — Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002 (Section 12): Record-keeping obligations — retain transaction records and KYC for 5 years and make them reconstructible for reporting/inspection.
- REG-PMLA-S12A — Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002 (Section 12A): Prohibition on tipping-off customers about STR/ FIU inquiries.
- REG-FIU-RF-019 — FIU-IND STR Red Flag Indicators (RF-019): Red flag for structuring/scatter-gather — transactions split across accounts/dates to evade CTR/wire-reporting thresholds.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P35 — RBI Master Direction on KYC (Para 35): Apply Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) when transaction volume/velocity is disproportionate to declared customer profile.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P46 — RBI Master Direction on KYC (Para 46): Require fresh CDD/PAN/OVD verification for accounts with expired/low KYC tiers that show high-value inter-bank transfers.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P41 — RBI Master Direction on KYC (Para 41): PEP accounts require senior approval, source-of-wealth checks and continuous EDD.

Short summary of obligations, immediate actions, and timelines (for alert ALT-V2-H0126 / ACC-H0126-RT00 and network accounts)
1. Escalation and STR filing
   - Escalate the case to your designated Principal Officer (REG-PMLA-R7).
   - If the Principal Officer is satisfied there are reasonable grounds of suspicion, file an STR to FIU-IND within seven working days of that satisfaction (REG-PMLA-R8).
   - Note: “Suspicious” may be triggered irrespective of nominal amount (REG-PMLA-R3).

2. EDD and CDD
   - Apply Enhanced Due Diligence (RBI Para 35) because the alert notes scatter-gather typology and unusual velocity across multiple network accounts (REG-FIU-RF-019; REG-RBI-KYC-P35).
   - Re-verify customer identity documents / PAN / OVD and transaction purpose for ACC-H0126-RT00 and each network account; perform source-of-funds/wealth checks and obtain senior management approval when needed (REG-RBI-KYC-P46; REG-RBI-KYC-P41).

3. Record keeping and confidentiality
   - Preserve all transaction trails, logs, KYC documents and investigative notes for at least five years, ensuring reconstructibility (REG-PMLA-S12).
   - Do not tip off the customer or any third party about the STR or ongoing inquiry (REG-PMLA-S12A).

4. Red-flag specifics to include in STR
   - Describe scatter-gather indicators: multiple inbound/outbound transfers across the listed network accounts, attempts to evade CTR thresholds, transaction velocity inconsistent with customer profile (cite REG-FIU-RF-019).
   - Attach transaction list, KYC snapshots, EDD findings, and any linked account analysis (per STR best practice and REG-PMLA-R8).

Notes/Context for this alert
- Investigation context: Alert ID ALT-V2-H0126, root account ACC-H0126-RT00, network accounts ACC-H0126-IN01..IN05 and ACC-H0126-DS01..DS03 (CASE ID: CASE-V2-0126). Use these identifiers in the STR and internal escalation.
- Regulatory citations above are the controlling references to satisfy FIU-IND/RBI/PMLA obligations.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

tool_calls.name: finish

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: get_alert_context
function.description: Retrieve seed account, network accounts, and initial transactions for an alert ID.

function.name: get_account_transactions
function.description: Fetch parameterized read-only transaction history for a specific account within `days_back`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

tool_calls.name: finish

Summary — regulatory hand-off HO-REG (ALT-V2-H0160)

Context (from hand-off)
- Alert ID: ALT-V2-H0160
- Root account: ACC-H0160-RT00
- Network accounts: ACC-H0160-IN01, ACC-H0160-IN02, ACC-H0160-DS01, ACC-H0160-DS02
- Finding: flow_tracer completed (35 evidence items)
- Observed amount of interest: INR 358,665.90

Relevant regulations and exact clause IDs
1. STR definition (no amount limit)
   - Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002 — Maintenance of Records Rules 2005, Rule 3
   - Clause ID: REG-PMLA-R3
   - Import: “Suspicious transaction … whether or not made in cash … regardless of amount.”

2. STR filing timeline / principal officer responsibility
   - PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005, Rule 8
   - Clause ID: REG-PMLA-R8
   - Import: STR to FIU-IND to be furnished by the Principal Officer within seven working days after being satisfied a transaction is suspicious.

3. Designation of Principal Officer and STR submission duty
   - PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005, Rule 7
   - Clause ID: REG-PMLA-R7

4. Confidentiality / prohibition on tipping off
   - Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002, Section 12A
   - Clause ID: REG-PMLA-S12A

5. Record-keeping requirement (KYC, transaction trails)
   - Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002, Section 12
   - Clause ID: REG-PMLA-S12

6. FIU-IND red-flag indicators relevant to scatter-gather / structuring
   - FIU-IND STR Red Flag Indicator — structured just below reporting threshold across multiple accounts/dates
   - Clause ID: REG-FIU-RF-019
   - FIU-IND STR Red Flag Indicator — sudden high-value scatter-gather velocity in newly opened or previously dormant accounts with immediate outward transfers
   - Clause ID: REG-FIU-RF-031

7. KYC / commercial verification expectations for high-velocity flows
   - RBI Master Direction on KYC — Para 51 (verify GSTIN/MCA/other commercial registration when treating flows as commercial)
   - Clause ID: REG-RBI-KYC-P51
   - RBI Master Direction on KYC — Para 46 (refresh CDD where minimal/expired KYC and high-value transfers occur)
   - Clause ID: REG-RBI-KYC-P46
   - RBI Master Direction on KYC — Para 41 (PEP handling if applicable)
   - Clause ID: REG-RBI-KYC-P41

Concise reporting guidance tied to observed facts (INR 358,665.90)
- No automatic safe-harbor by amount: per REG-PMLA-R3, suspiciousness is not constrained by value. INR 358,665.90 can require an STR if facts indicate laundering risk.
- Consider STR if the flow fits scatter-gather/structuring patterns described in REG-FIU-RF-019 and REG-FIU-RF-031:
  - Multiple deposits/credits across the network accounts (ACC-H0160-*) that aggregate or cycle funds,
  - Rapid in/out movement from newly opened or dormant accounts,
  - Repeated transfers just below internal or statutory thresholds or timed to evade monitoring,
  - Lack of commercial rationale, mismatched counterparty identity (no valid GSTIN/registration) or inconsistent source-of-funds explanations.
- Immediate actions for the Principal Officer (per REG-PMLA-R7, REG-PMLA-R8):
  1. Review and document all transaction chains and KYC for root and network accounts (meet REG-PMLA-S12 record requirements).
  2. Refresh CDD where KYC is minimal or outdated (REG-RBI-KYC-P46). Verify GSTIN/MCA or other business credentials before concluding payments are commercial (REG-RBI-KYC-P51).
  3. If indicators from RF-019 or RF-031 are present and commercial justification is inadequate, prepare and file an STR to FIU-IND within seven working days (REG-PMLA-R8).
  4. Do not tip off customers — maintain confidentiality (REG-PMLA-S12A).
- Content to include in STR (typical required indicators):
  - Transaction summary and timeline showing INR 358,665.90 movement and any aggregation/velocity across ACC-H0160-* accounts.
  - Reasons for suspicion tied to FIU red flags (REG-FIU-RF-019, REG-FIU-RF-031): structuring, scatter-gather, sudden activation of dormant accounts, rapid outward transfers.
  - KYC status and any gaps or discrepancies (REG-PMLA-S12; REG-RBI-KYC-P46, REG-RBI-KYC-P51).
  - Counterparty identities, GSTIN/registration evidence or absence thereof.
  - Any links to PEPs or adverse information if present (REG-RBI-KYC-P41).
  - Attach reconstructable transaction trail and supporting documents per record-keeping rules.

Operational recommendation for this case
- Given flow_tracer output (35 evidence items) and multiple network accounts, analyst should:
  1. Reconstruct the full trail (timestamps, inbound/outbound legs) and map any aggregation patterns across the four network accounts.
  2. Check account age, prior dormancy, KYC completeness and verification timestamps for each account (use REG-RBI-KYC-P46 guidance).
  3. Seek business-registration evidence for counterparties before treating as legitimate commercial settlement (REG-RBI-KYC-P51).
  4. If structuring/scatter-gather indicators are present and commercial explanations are inadequate, escalate to Principal Officer and file STR within seven working days (REG-PMLA-R7, REG-PMLA-R8).
  5. Preserve all records and avoid any customer tipping-off (REG-PMLA-S12, REG-PMLA-S12A).

Key clause ID list (for hand-off)
- REG-PMLA-R3, REG-PMLA-R7, REG-PMLA-R8, REG-PMLA-S12, REG-PMLA-S12A
- REG-FIU-RF-019, REG-FIU-RF-031
- REG-RBI-KYC-P46, REG-RBI-KYC-P51, REG-RBI-KYC-P41

function.name: get_alert_context
function.description: Retrieve seed account, network accounts, and initial transactions for an alert ID.

function.name: get_account_transactions
function.description: Fetch parameterized read-only transaction history for a specific account within `days_back`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: get_alert_context
function.description: Retrieve seed account, network accounts, and initial transactions for an alert ID.

function.name: get_account_transactions
function.description: Fetch parameterized read-only transaction history for a specific account within `days_back`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

response.text:
Summary of applicable regulations and clauses (exact IDs cited)
- REG-FIU-RF-019 — FIU-IND STR Red Flag Indicators (RF-019): transactions structured just below the INR 10,00,000 CTR/wire reporting threshold across multiple accounts to evade monitoring.
- REG-FIU-RF-031 — FIU-IND STR Red Flag Indicators (RF-031): sudden high-value scatter‑gather velocity in newly opened or dormant accounts followed by immediate outward transfers.
- REG-PMLA-R3 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 (Rule 3): definition of suspicious transaction — can be any transaction that gives reasonable grounds for suspicion, regardless of amount.
- REG-PMLA-R8 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 (Rule 8): Principal Officer must file Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) to FIU‑IND not later than seven working days after being satisfied a transaction is suspicious.
- REG-PMLA-R7 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 (Rule 7): requirement to designate a Principal Officer responsible for review and STR filing.
- REG-PMLA-S12 — Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002 (Section 12): record‑keeping obligations (retain transaction trails and KYC for prescribed period).
- REG-RBI-KYC-P51 — RBI Master Direction on KYC (Para 51): verify commercial purpose (GSTIN/MCA/other registrations) before treating scatter‑gather as benign commercial settlement.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P64 — RBI Master Direction on KYC (Para 64): preserve accurate originator/beneficiary identifiers for end‑to‑end reconstruction.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P41 — RBI Master Direction on KYC (Para 41): enhanced measures for PEPs and source-of-wealth verification (cited as relevant if any PEP exposure).

Immediate assessment vs. thresholds
- The observed transfer amount INR 546,888.18 is below the INR 1,000,000 (10 lakh) CTR/wire threshold referenced in RF-019, so a CTR based solely on a single transaction amount is not triggered.
- However, REG-PMLA-R3 makes clear an STR may be required regardless of amounts when there are reasonable grounds for suspicion.
- The pattern described in context (scatter‑gather across network accounts, flow tracer evidence, and the RF-019/RF-031 indicators) is consistent with structuring/evading threshold monitoring and triggers suspicion even though individual transfers are below 10 lakh.

Recommended regulatory actions (prioritized)
1. Escalate to Principal Officer immediately (REG-PMLA-R7).
2. File a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) to FIU‑IND within seven working days if, after review, the Principal Officer is satisfied there are reasonable grounds for suspicion (REG-PMLA-R8 and REG-PMLA-R3). Cite RF indicators in narrative (REG-FIU-RF-019, REG-FIU-RF-031).
3. Perform Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) on root and network accounts:
   - Verify identity and KYC completeness, source of funds/wealth, recent account opening/reactivation history (REG-RBI-KYC-P41).
   - Verify commercial justification: obtain GSTIN/MCA/contracting documents or recurring counterparty settlement evidence before treating flows as legitimate commercial settlements (REG-RBI-KYC-P51).
4. Preserve and produce transaction trails, messages, and KYC records for at least the statutory retention period and ensure full reconstructability (REG-PMLA-S12; REG-RBI-KYC-P64).
5. Consider temporary preventive measures per internal policy and legal counsel:
   - If there are reasonable grounds to suspect money‑laundering and internal policy permits, consider blocking or placing holds on suspicious outgoing transactions pending STR filing/clarification. function.name: get_alert_context
function.description: Retrieve seed account, network accounts, and initial transactions for an alert ID.

function.name: get_account_transactions
function.description: Fetch parameterized read-only transaction history for a specific account within `days_back`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

Summary — regulatory clauses, thresholds, and recommended EDD/escalation for scatter-gather patterns and transactions ≥ INR 17,188,142.39

Key regulatory clauses (exact IDs)
- REG-FIU-RF-019 — FIU-IND STR Red Flag Indicator RF-019: transactions structured just below INR 10,00,000 CTR/wire thresholds across multiple accounts or staggered dates to evade reporting. (useful for identifying structuring / smurfing / scatter-gather)
- REG-FIU-RF-031 — FIU-IND STR RF-031: sudden high-value scatter-gather velocity in newly opened or dormant accounts followed by immediate outward IMPS/RTGS transfers.
- REG-FIU-RF-027 — FIU-IND STR RF-027: multi‑tier layering (4–5 hops) with intermediaries routing funds to final consolidation accounts.
- REG-FIU-RF-023 — FIU-IND STR RF-023: intermediary mule accounts retaining commission before forwarding funds (fee-skimming sign).
- REG-RBI-KYC-P35 — RBI Master Direction Para 35: apply Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) where transaction volume/velocity is disproportionate to declared income/occupation/expected activity.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P51 — RBI Master Direction Para 51: before closing high-value scatter-gather flows as benign commercial settlements, verify active GSTIN / MCA / Section 80G registration and recurring settlement cadence.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P46 — RBI Master Direction Para 46: accounts with expired/minimal KYC showing high-value inter‑bank transfers must undergo fresh CDD and PAN/OVD verification.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P38 — RBI Master Direction Para 38: customer risk categorization (Low/Medium/High) based on identity, business, counterparties, location.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P41 — RBI Master Direction Para 41: PEP accounts require senior management approval, source-of-wealth checks, continuous enhanced monitoring.
- REG-PMLA-S12 — PMLA 2002 Section 12: maintain records for 5 years; furnish prescribed reports to Director, FIU-IND.
- REG-PMLA-R3 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules Rule 3: definition/obligation to report suspicious transactions (suspicion is not amount‑limited).
- REG-FATF-R20 — FATF Recommendation 20: report suspicious transactions promptly when reasonable grounds exist (no need to determine guilt).

Hand-off HO-REG — regulatory brief and action checklist (concise)

Summary of applicable rules / critical citations
- STR filing timeline: Principal Officer must furnish an STR to FIU‑IND not later than seven working days after being satisfied the transaction is suspicious. (PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 — Rule 8; clause ID: REG-PMLA-R8).
- Definition / threshold independence: A transaction may be “suspicious” regardless of amount — suspicion is not limited to breaches of numeric thresholds. (PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 — Rule 3; REG-PMLA-R3).
- CTR / structuring red flag: FIU‑IND red-flag: transactions structured below the INR 10,00,000 CTR threshold across multiple accounts/dates to evade reporting. Pattern you describe (INR 12,176,957.77 scatter‑gather across many accounts) is squarely within structuring/layering indicators. (FIU‑IND STR Red Flag Indicators — RF-019; REG-FIU-RF-019).
- Layering/rapid pass-through indicator: Rapid/staggered pass‑through transfers across unrelated accounts with no economic rationale and consolidation within ~14–30 days warrants STR scrutiny. (FIU‑IND RF-014; REG-FIU-RF-014).
- Shell / questionable corporate activity: Corporate accounts with trading claims but missing bona fide corporate documentation (CIN, GST filings, transactional history) are red flags for shell entities. (FIU‑IND RF-036; REG-FIU-RF-036).
- Intermediary/mule behavior: Repeated intermediary accounts retaining a regular fee/commission prior to forwarding funds is a known indicator. (FIU‑IND RF-023; REG-FIU-RF-023).
- Principal Officer obligation: Reporting entities must designate a Principal Officer responsible for review and STR submission. (PMLA Rules — Rule 7; REG-PMLA-R7).
- Record-keeping and confidentiality: Maintain transaction/KYC records for the statutory period (5 years) and do not tip off the customer about STR or FIU inquiries. (PMLA / PMLA Rules — Section 12, Section 12A; REG-PMLA-S12, REG-PMLA-S12A).
- FATF standard: Timely reporting of suspicious transactions is required when reasonable grounds for suspicion exist; do not attempt to determine criminal guilt before reporting. (FATF Rec 20; REG-FATF-R20).

Interpretation for the current pattern (INR 12,176,957.77 scatter‑gather across multiple network accounts)
- The pattern matches FIU‑IND red flags for structuring/layering (REG-FIU-RF-019, REG-FIU-RF-014), and possibly mule/intermediary behavior (REG-FIU-RF-023). The amount (INR 12,176,957.77) consolidated after scatter-gather does not remove suspicion because PMLA defines suspicious transactions irrespective of amount (REG-PMLA-R3).
- Corporate scattering (funds moved across multiple corporate accounts lacking legitimate trade/evidence) raises the shell‑entity red flag (REG-FIU-RF-036).

Immediate compliance actions (recommended, ordered by priority)
1. Escalate to the Principal Officer immediately for review and decision (PMLA Rule 7 — REG-PMLA-R7).
2. Preserve and secure records: freeze/lock related transaction logs, KYC files, communications, account opening data, and payment instructions for the statutory retention period. Do not notify the customer about the review (REG-PMLA-S12, REG-PMLA-S12A).
3. Perform enhanced due diligence on all involved accounts: obtain/verify corporate documents (MCA CIN, GST returns, business contracts, invoices, bank statement history), beneficial ownership, and source/purpose of funds. Look for repeated commission/fee patterns and common ultimate beneficiaries (REG-FIU-RF-023, REG-FIU-RF-036).
4. Sanctions/PEP screening: run all implicated entities and beneficiaries through sanctions and PEP lists as part of normal AML checks (consistent with RBI/FIU expectations and FATF guidance — REG-FATF-R20).
5. If, after review, reasonable grounds of suspicion exist, file an STR to FIU‑IND without delay — and in any event within seven working days of being satisfied of suspicion (REG-PMLA-R8; REG-PMLA-R3). Do not delay to wait for law-enforcement confirmation.
6. Document decision rationale: retain the Principal Officer’s assessment, supporting evidence, and the STR filing record (if filed) per record‑keeping rules (REG-PMLA-S12).

Minimum trigger threshold for action (practical)
- Although CTR numeric thresholds are relevant for automated reporting, this pattern is a clear STR trigger even though the consolidated amount is slightly above common CTR thresholds; PMLA requires STRs where reasonable suspicion exists regardless of amount (REG-PMLA-R3). FIU‑IND RF indicators explicitly call out structuring below INR 10,00,000 as suspicious (REG-FIU-RF-019); your observed scatter/gather across multiple accounts therefore warrants STR consideration.

Suggested STR content to FIU‑IND (high level)
- Summary of the scatter‑gather pattern, list of involved accounts (root + network accounts), transaction timeline, amounts (exact figures), identified red flags (structuring, layering, intermediaries, missing corporate documentation), results of EDD / sanctions screening, and principal officer assessment. Cite internal evidence items and preserve attachments.

Caveats / legal limits
- Do not infer or allege criminal guilt in internal reports — file facts and reasonable grounds for suspicion (PMLA/FATF guidance; REG-PMLA-R3, REG-FATF-R20).
- Follow internal escalation and legal counsel guidance for any freeze or law‑enforcement notification beyond STR filing.

Key clause IDs to include in hand-off to FIU/compliance/legal
- REG-PMLA-R8 (PMLA Rules — STR filing within seven working days)
- REG-PMLA-R3 (Definition: suspicious regardless of amount)

function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

response.text:
Hand-off HO-REG — regulatory search executed. Relevant clauses found and actions recommended below (concise).

Key regulatory citations (exact IDs)
- REG-PMLA-R3 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 (Rule 3): definition of "suspicious transaction" (no amount threshold).
- REG-PMLA-R8 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 (Rule 8): STR to FIU-IND not later than seven working days once satisfied transaction is suspicious.

- REG-PMLA-R8 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005, Rule 8: “The Principal Officer of a reporting entity shall furnish the Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) to FIU-IND not later than seven working days on being satisfied that the transaction is suspicious.”
- REG-PMLA-R3 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005, Rule 3: defines “suspicious transaction” and states suspicion may exist “whether or not made in cash” and “regardless of amount.”
- REG-PMLA-S12 / PMLA 2002 Section 12 — record-keeping obligation: maintain transaction/KYC records (5 years) and furnish prescribed reports to FIU-IND.
- REG-PMLA-S12A — PMLA 2002 Section 12A: prohibition on tipping off customers about STRs/FIU inquiries.
- REG-FIU-RF-019 — FIU-IND Red Flag: structuring/transactions split below reporting thresholds (“scatter/gather” to evade threshold-based monitoring) is a red flag.
- REG-FIU-RF-031 — FIU-IND Red Flag: sudden high-velocity scatter/gather in new or dormant accounts followed by immediate outward transfers is a red flag.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P51 — RBI Master Direction on KYC, Para 51: require commercial verification (GSTIN/MCA etc.) before clearing high-value scatter/gather flows as benign settlements.

4. Record and escalation obligations: maintain supporting records (5 years) and escalate to Principal Officer (REG-PMLA-S12, REG-PMLA-R7).

6. Confidentiality: do not tip-off the customer about the STR or investigation (REG-PMLA-S12A).

Does the observed pattern meet statutory STR/SAR criteria?
- By regulatory standard: yes — the pattern (scatter/gather behavior, velocity across network accounts, amount INR 334,887.17 distributed/aggregated to evade thresholds) aligns with enumerated FIU red flags (REG-FIU-RF-019 and REG-FIU-RF-031). 5. Do not tip off the customer or related parties (REG-PMLA-S12A).

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

parameters.description: Terminal tool submitting the structured `DispositionWorksheet` draft for deterministic verification.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.

tool_calls.name: finish

function.name: get_alert_context
function.description: Retrieve seed account, network accounts, and initial transactions for an alert ID.

function.name: get_account_transactions
function.description: Fetch parameterized read-only transaction history for a specific account within `days_back`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: get_alert_context
function.description: Retrieve seed account, network accounts, and initial transactions for an alert ID.

function.name: get_account_transactions
function.description: Fetch parameterized read-only transaction history for a specific account within `days_back`.

function.name: find_candidate_fund_flows
function.description: Run deterministic MultiDiGraph fund-flow path reconstruction with exact Decimal math.

parameters.description: Graph flow search input; `transactions` defaults to all transactions already loaded in state.

transactions.description: Optional explicit transaction list; omit to analyze all transactions fetched in this session.

function.name: compute_flow_conservation
function.description: Compute exact Decimal inflow/outflow conservation and structuring flags across candidate paths.

parameters.description: Decimal flow conservation check over reconstructed candidate paths.

path_ids.description: Path IDs (e.g. ['PATH-1']) to verify; omit/empty to check top reconstructed multi-hop paths.

function.name: compare_graph_runs
function.description: Compare the previous and latest graph runs to identify newly discovered paths.

parameters.description: Compare the two most recent graph scans to inspect newly uncovered consolidation paths.

note.description: Optional note explaining what delta is being checked

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

- REG-PMLA-S12 — Prevention of Money Laundering Act 2002 (Section 12): record‑keeping: maintain transaction records and KYC for the prescribed period (five years) and make trails reconstructable.
- REG-FIU-RF-019 — FIU‑IND STR Red Flag (RF‑019): structuring/transactions split just below INR 10,00,000 (cash reporting threshold) across multiple accounts/dates to evade monitoring — red flag for suspiciousness.
- REG-FIU-RF-014 — FIU‑IND STR Red Flag (RF‑014): rapid/staggered pass‑through transfers across unrelated accounts with minimal residual balances and no clear economic rationale; consolidation within ~14–30 days warrants STR scrutiny.
- REG-FIU-RF-027 — FIU‑IND STR Red Flag (RF‑027): multi‑tier layering through intermediary/shell accounts across multiple hops (4–5) before consolidation — indicator of layering.
- REG-FIU-RF-031 — FIU‑IND STR Red Flag (RF‑031): sudden high‑velocity scatter‑gather in newly opened or previously dormant accounts followed by immediate outward transfers.
- REG-RBI-KYC-P51 — RBI Master Direction on KYC (Para 51): require verification of commercial/legal basis (GSTIN, MCA, Section 80G etc.) before clearing high‑value scatter‑gather flows as legitimate.
- REG-FATF-R20 — FATF Recommendation 20: financial institutions should report suspicious transactions promptly when reasonable grounds exist (do not determine criminal guilt prior to reporting).
- REG-PMLA-R3 — PMLA Maintenance of Records Rules 2005 (Rule 3): definition of suspicious transaction — suspicion may exist regardless of amount if complexity/unusual features are present.

Why this alert meets reportable/suspicious criteria (short)
- Scatter‑gather pattern across multiple accounts, multiple hops and consolidation (matches RF‑014, RF‑027).
- Possible structuring/velocity close to known reporting thresholds (RF‑019) and amount flagged (INR 1,047,883.38) — even if below/above a particular CTR threshold, structuring and unusual velocity are standalone indicators of suspicion (REG-PMLA-R3, RF‑019).
- Use of newly active/dormant accounts in the path is an additional red flag (RF‑031).
- No clear economic/commercial rationale visible in the alert data — triggers requirement to verify counterparty legal/commercial status before clearance (REG-RBI-KYC-P51).

Mandatory actions and timelines (stepwise)
1. Immediate internal escalation
   - Escalate the alert to the designated Principal Officer without delay (REG-PMLA-R7).

2. Analyst review and commercial verification (short window)

3. STR decision and filing
   - If the Principal Officer is satisfied there are reasonable grounds of suspicion (structuring, layering, scatter‑gather velocity, lack of economic rationale), file a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) to FIU‑IND.

4. Record retention and audit trail

5. Avoid commentary implying guilt
   - Do not assert criminal guilt in internal notes or STRs; describe observable facts, rationale for suspicion, and supporting evidence (REG-FATF-R20 guidance).

Hand-off HO-REG — regulatory summary and recommended actions (concise)

Key regulatory clauses and red flags (exact IDs)
- FIU-IND STR Red Flag — structuring / scatter-gather: REG-FIU-RF-019 (transactions structured just below CTR/wire thresholds across multiple accounts or staggered dates).  
- FIU-IND STR Red Flag — dormant/reactivated accounts with rapid outflows: REG-FIU-RF-031.
- PMLA — definition of suspicious transaction (no amount threshold; suspicion based on reasonable grounds): REG-PMLA-R3.
- PMLA — Principal Officer duties (designation, review, STR submission responsibility): REG-PMLA-R7.
- PMLA — STR submission timeline: REG-PMLA-R8 (STR to FIU-IND not later than seven working days once satisfied transaction is suspicious).
- PMLA / Records — retention and reconstructability (5 years): REG-PMLA-S12.
- PMLA — prohibition on tipping-off customers: REG-PMLA-S12A.
- RBI KYC — commercial verification requirements before treating high-value scatter-gather as benign (GSTIN/MCA/recurring cadence): REG-RBI-KYC-P51.
- RBI KYC — PEP handling and enhanced monitoring: REG-RBI-KYC-P41.
- FATF standard on STR reporting (no judicial determination of guilt required): REG-FATF-R20.

Application to the current alert (ALT-V2-H0101; root ACC-H0101-RT00; network ACC-H0101-IN01/IN02/IN03/DS01)
- Relevant pattern: flow_finding indicates flow_tracer populated evidence (18 items). The FIU-IND red flags REG-FIU-RF-019 and REG-FIU-RF-031 directly cover scatter-gather and sudden high-velocity flows from newly active/dormant accounts — this matches the alert description and warrants elevated scrutiny.
- Because REG-PMLA-R3 defines suspiciousness irrespective of amount, structured flows designed to evade thresholds are reportable even if individual transactions fall below formal CTR or wire thresholds (REG-FIU-RF-019 reinforces this behavior as a red flag).
- Before closing as legitimate commercial activity, verify commercial credentials and settlement patterns per REG-RBI-KYC-P51 (GSTIN, company registration, invoices, recurring settlement cadence). If counterparties are PEPs, apply REG-RBI-KYC-P41.

Immediate recommended actions (operational steps tied to clauses)
1. Escalate to the Principal Officer immediately for review (REG-PMLA-R7). Attach all 18 evidence items and a short rationale referencing REG-FIU-RF-019 and REG-FIU-RF-031.

5. Do not tip off the customer(s) about the investigation or STR (REG-PMLA-S12A).
6. Use FATF guidance that reporting is required on reasonable suspicion without concluding guilt as a policy anchor when drafting STR narrative (REG-FATF-R20).

If closing as benign
- Document the commercial verification performed (documents reviewed and who approved), cite REG-RBI-KYC-P51, and retain justification in records (REG-PMLA-S12). Ensure Principal Officer sign-off (REG-PMLA-R7).

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: calc
function.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`); registers a `CALC-*` evidence entry.

parameters.description: Exact Decimal calculator (`sum`, `diff`, `pct`, `compare`) so the LLM never computes mental math.

op.description: Operation: 'sum' (sum all values), 'diff' (a - b), 'pct' ((a / b) * 100), 'compare' (a vs b).

values.description: Exact numeric strings from tool outputs (e.g. ['900000.00', '828000.00']); 2 items for diff/pct.

label.description: Short description of what figure is being computed

function.name: finish
function.description: Complete the investigation and submit a structured worksheet with both hypotheses and missing evidence.

recommendation_rationale.description: Concise rationale citing exact tool IDs and copying INR figures verbatim from tool outputs.

suspicious_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

benign_hypothesis.description: Structured hypothesis entry required for both `suspicious` and `benign` perspectives.

missing_evidence.description: Explicit list of missing or out-of-band evidence items (required on every case).

regulatory_citations.description: Verified regulatory clause IDs retrieved from `compliance-kb`.
